narrative:
## Handover Summary — Fee & Commission

Fee and insurance plan approved. Together with NII, total income reconciles to the EUR 336M baseline plus accepted uplifts.

## Key Decisions
• Fund volume growth of 7% accepted; fee-yield compression of 2bp absorbed
• Unit-linked uplift tied to private-banking bundling in Helsinki and Turku
• Institutional mandate included at 55% probability

## Recommendation for Cost Base
Income is set. The COO now owns the numerator: holding opex near EUR 196M keeps C/I at 58.3%.
